data.name: Msa
data.gender_notes: Msa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘maha’, meaning great, and ‘sakti’, meaning power. Msa is the name of the Hindu goddess of wisdom and knowledge, often depicted holding a lotus and a book. The name Msa carries the meaning “Goddess of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Msa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment and the pursuit of knowledge.
data.etymology: Msa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Msa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Msa, as a Hindu name, carries the rich tradition and influence of ancient Indian philosophy and culture. It represents wisdom, power, and knowledge, values deeply rooted in Indian society and spiritual practices.
data.spiritual_significance: Msa, as a divine name given to the Hindu goddess of wisdom, Maasathar, is deeply spiritual and symbolic. It signifies the power of knowledge and wisdom, and the idea that through knowledge and understanding, one can overcome challenges and attain enlightenment. Msa embodies the idea that wisdom is the highest form of power, and that seeking knowledge and wisdom is a noble and sacred pursuit. Additionally, the name Msa highlights the important role of women in Hindu spirituality and mythology, as Maasathar is one of many powerful goddesses revered in the Hindu tradition.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Msa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Maasaa', meaning 'mother'. It is a reverential name representing the divine nurturing and protective qualities of the universe and the feminine goddess energy.
